title: An entry of modules.yaml, the module registry and its map of realisations
description: One entry of a store's modules.yaml (brain modules, docs/modules.md): a module of the platform the brain builds. The document fields (name, brick, phase, status, placement, definition, declared, divergences, source, imported) are an import's (brain.modules); the map's fields (wanted, capabilities, depends_on, uses, ai, realized_by, map_review) are written by hand (brain.modulemap). brain modules --check validates an entry against this schema only when it carries realized_by or map_review: a registry with neither is checked as before. Other fields (the document fields, lab, since, note...) are not constrained here. A realisation's unknown key is a newer brain's: a note in read mode, an error in strict mode (CI). No v: the registry is a YAML list; a change of this schema moves its format (docs/release.md).

id.description: The module's id, unique in the registry (P2, B7).

wanted.description: Whether the brain's owner wants the module: true asks for a realisation or an open item that builds it; brain modules --check flags one with neither, and warns of one with no item done or open 90 days after its since.

capabilities.description: The engine's capabilities (tiers.yaml) that realise the module in a brain: what enabling the module turns on.

depends_on.description: The modules it needs (hard dependencies), ids of the registry; classified by hand from the documents' declared ones.

uses.description: The modules it uses when they are there (soft dependencies), ids of the registry. A declared dependency in neither depends_on nor uses counts as soft and the view lists it to classify.

ai.description: Whether the module is AI (a model): what a preset that forbids AI leaves out.

map_review.description: Where the entry's map fields stand: proposed (written by a session, waiting on the owner's review) or validated (reviewed by the owner).

realized_by.description: Who realises the module and where, one entry per realisation.

project.description: The project that realises it: a name of the projects registry (projects.yaml), read-only projects included.

kind.description: lab: a laboratory realisation, retired once a target one takes over; product: the product's; brain: the brain engine's; app: an application of the owner's software hub.

what.description: What the realisation is, in a few words.

paths.description: Where it lives in the project's repo, relative to its root: checked at ref when the project's checkout is on this machine.

ref.description: The git ref the paths are checked at; default HEAD.

licence.description: Its licence (SPDX id or a name).

state.description: Its state: planned, building, pr-open, partial, built, running (in service) or retired.

contract.description: The contract it exposes (a format, an API, with its version).

retire.description: For a lab realisation, the condition of its retirement.
